Plugin.Name: Asustor Control
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: asustor as6706t lockerstor nas lcd led bay fan temperature history hwmon
Plugin.Overview:
Drives the front-panel LCD and LEDs of an Asustor NAS running Unraid, and shows the AS6706T as it looks, with its bays live.
- Overview: the AS6706T drawn front and rear, each bay with its drive, temperature and state; no drive is woken. Fan, CPU and drive temperatures, the LCD preview and an action log. - Bay labels on the Main page. - The LCD cycles through the screens you pick: hostname, IP address, temperatures, array status, time and uptime, fan. - Front-panel LEDs: per-bay activity and fault LEDs, a status LED that follows the array, and Locate. The USB Copy button can log, notify, locate or run your own script. - History of the CPU and drive temperatures and the fan. - A hardware inventory with known issues and firmware. - A Report tab that anonymises what your unit looks like, for support of other models.
It needs the kernel drivers from the Asustor Platform Drivers plugin. Fan control stays with FanCtrl Plus: this plugin has no fan curve of its own.
Experimental. Tested on the AS6706T.
